notes: Worker Frens ART launch on Ethereum: deploy WorkerArt1 and WorkerArt2 from src/art/WorkerArt.sol without constructor arguments, then WorkerFrensRenderer from src/frens/WorkerFrensRenderer.sol with those two addresses in order. The data contracts contain the repository's unchanged art as STOP followed by PUSH32-framed data. The renderer draws on chain using these chunks and the IMD swarm's FrenArtChunk1..7 already on Ethereum, checking each chunk's code hash on every read. Its nonpayable constructor checks the two new chunks' code hashes against WorkerArtIndex, reverts BadArt on mismatch, and makes no calls, allowing deployment on a fresh chain. None of the three contracts has an owner or any role. The launch requires no ETH funding or initialization calls. test_EachLaunchFitsOneTransaction prices the complete art launch at about 13.6M gas, including creations, calldata at EIP-7623 rates and launcher overhead, with at least 1M gas below EIP-7825's 2^24 limit. PlaceFrens and PlaceModules are a separate collection launch. After both launches, the team wallet connects the collection using script/frens/DeployFrens.s.sol setup(), with MODULES set to the collection's PlaceModules and RENDERER set to this launch's confirmed WorkerFrensRenderer address. That collection setup is outside this manifest. FrensPlacementForkTest requires MAINNET_RPC_URL to compare the rendered art byte for byte with script/art/data/expected.json. The accepted contract sources, art, salts and build settings are unchanged.
